foundry_grant.description: Owner, on operator direction: request one scoped baseline, candidate reuse, restoration, observer, preview approval or production grant.

inspectBaseline.description: Allow the original missing-input writers to read their exact prior directories. No write permission or new work; eligible even during a check.

repairBaseline.description: Authorize one bounded repair for each original missing-input writer from its unchanged baseline after a settled goal. Inspection alone does not authorize repair.

reuse.description: Seed one new writer from the exhausted assignment's exact failed candidate and already-offered correction on the current product. No old verdict is promoted.

restore.description: Attest only the unchanged orphaned primary of a formerly checked mixed grant. The retaining owner keeps all integration files. Name the historical/current product and settled goal checks.

observer.description: Authorize a writer for one existing observer file after a signed negative pair. For a final replacement supply its predecessor's failed check, candidate, phases and approved file blob. No production edits.

approveObserver.description: Review and approve the bound writer's exact observer preview and fault controls. Use the same grant inputs; this does not authorize another writer.

production.description: After the final signed diagnostic fails, grant the named producer exact production and regression files. No observer edit or replay; both components, product and goal need fresh passes.

foundry_check.description: Owner, on operator request: recover a check, observe or repeat a historical harness, or pair a failed restoration with its retainer. Never replace a verdict.

recover.description: Recover a confirmed pre-claim launcher exit or signed null goal on its current pins. No retry of an unknown call.

observe.description: Append a non-qualifying observation of a stopped numeric component on the full current checked commit. Approve the complete historical test harness and account for changed inputs kept current; do not guess unknown inputs.

repeat.description: Only on explicit repeat request: inherit the approved harness and inputs of the latest signed observation on the same product.

pair.description: After a signed exit-1 restoration, observe the same primary with the published retainer's different integration bytes. Name the unchanged checkpoint, goal and passing retainer component. No writer, edits or retry of a negative pair.

foundry_review.description: Owner: start one scoped scout comparison or retry an eligible blocked review. To queue context without a launch use foundry_review_note.

compare.description: Open a scoped comparison of an offered blob in its production directory. Use the unmet goal receipt, or the passing checkpoint check while its goal is pending. On a settled exit 2, use the current goal and a checked source for a new approved review, or historical evidence for an omitted same-product failure. A superseded exhausted-directory overlap can use its original directory/blob on unchanged inputs.

files.description: Exact existing integration files for a source-backed review; never grants a parent directory.

transfer.description: Conditional transfer from the qualified parent to a new ID. Requires source, files and an exclusion-aware checker.

successor.description: Separately approved narrower assignment after a writer stop. Requires source and the original signed component check. Cannot release an ownership hold.

retry.description: On explicit request, recover one existing blocked review with proven scout-budget failure or missing approved source. Issue one fresh scout on the same comparison, never replay its report.

foundry_deliver.description: Owner, on request: approve the inventory of whole, absent, disjoint test directories with latest signed passing reruns on this product. Preserve owners and attempts; freshly check components, product and goal.

foundry_checkpoint.description: Owner, on request after a failed paired observer: verify one non-release subset of published outputs. Prove complete build and runtime inputs for selected and held components; unknown inputs are ineligible. No retry or release.

foundry_workspace.description: Pooled writer: open or verify this assignment's checkout inside your native worktree. Work only in the returned workspace. No branch switch, old-work copy or check.

foundry_correct.description: Owner: approve removing one contradictory clause from an unsubmitted task. Cite the assigning review and frozen verbatim source, in grant for a checked handoff. A bound writer rereads status; only an ordinary missing-input stop without a verdict can use its exact preview for one same-writer repair. No new read grant or check.

foundry_attribute.description: Owner: route a shared failure missing from structured blocker data. Quote the current unmet goal receipt. Count dependent journeys not run, excluding the failure; this changes scheduling, not its verdict.

foundry_configure.description: Owner, on request: change future reservations at the current scheduling revision. workers:null restores the brief ceiling. checkpointReviews governs new checkpoint comparisons and surveys, not existing work.

foundry_preview.description: Bound writer, after joining helpers: pin all assigned roots on the frozen generation for inspection. No submission, evaluator or change of authority.

foundry_review_note.description: Owner: queue a historical goal receipt and question for a squad's next normal review. Use a proof receipt ID and optional verbatim excerpt. No discovery or assignment.

foundry_start.description: On explicit operator direction, activate a new run for a committed .foundry brief. Repeating start does not advance or resume an existing run. Use foundry_resume for recovery.

foundry_resume.description: On explicit owner request, continue an existing source from its ledger pins. Use run to disambiguate. Never create a run or replay an issued call.

foundry_pause.description: Stop new Foundry work without discarding native calls, evidence, worktrees or checked products.

foundry_claim.description: Bind an existing uncertain writer only. The child proves its kickoff and native session identity by token or grain; the original issuer confirms by grain. Never launch another writer.

foundry_retire.description: On explicit owner request and native proof, approve retiring a dead pre-journal goal reservation without a verdict. Integrate retained work; never rerun the old goal.

foundry_clarify.description: On explicit owner request, reopen the exact lost charter dialog from status. Only the operator answers. No contract change or permission grant.

foundry_repin.description: Owner, on request: omit kind for a goal-only diff; product rechecks the same checkpoint; target adopts a reviewed mixed descendant. Name the exact diff and pins. Target adoption requires explicit approval, acceptance changes, any exact unowned conflict resolutions, and fresh component/product/goal checks. No branch change or retroactive grant.

foundry_submit.description: Bound writer, after joining helpers: submit all assigned roots, or report one stop. Use missingInput for a genuine missing input; cannotRepair for a status-listed check when further repair is forbidden; relinquish for a status-listed numeric failure with neither a fix nor missing input. Stops do not capture or recheck. For changed work after an incomplete check use changedFrom from status.

foundry_publish.description: Offer one reference file to named output directories or charter areas. A bound writer must supply its token. Publishing grants no baseline access or repair authority.

foundry_status.description: Read scoped work, blockers and receipts without advancing or archiving. permissions reads this issuer's live policy and mode; proof, cleanup and usage are owner-only.

foundry_reference.description: Bound researcher only: read permitted UTF-8 text at a published commit in a local sibling repository. Not working-tree or visual evidence.
